groups.ADAPTATION_UNSEEN_PARENT: Parent absent from current training and every adaptation ancestor of chosen initialization. Exact geometry duplicate groups held out together; near-duplicate scope disclosed.
groups.REGRESSION: Previously used DEV and historical TRAIN panels remain separately identified; never relabel as independent test.
groups.SAME_PARENT_HELDOUT_C: Same current training parent, reserved source-face region and C geometry; not an independent-parent generalization claim.
groups.TRAIN_KNOWN_C: Current training parent and exact trained C; fixed generated noise registered separately.

required_before_training: parent/condition split frozen before model results
noise files and hashes registered without worker-dependent RNG
C adoption + body + support judged on the same output; CF/FF/I/fragments/deletion costs retained
source_target_usage: Supervision and task validity only; hidden completion is not an inference input.
